payload.reason: The evidence provides specific results from previous studies, including improvements in F1 scores and comparisons of model performance.

claims.text: Substantial improvements over previously reported results were achieved, with at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperformed BERT and RoBERTa in the context of this study, which contrasts with results on other benchmark datasets.
Joint training on multiple datasets outperformed single dataset training approaches by a significant margin.
